sensitivity_limit: The 10 m to 20 m domain change also changes the global air mesh (domain/40). Results are combined domain/global-mesh sensitivity, not isolated domain convergence. A finite A=0 boundary replaces COMSOL infinite elements.
development_corrections: Initial uniform-field checks used signed positive targets despite original negative shell directions. Corrected to source-defined field magnitude, retaining signed components. Initial failed reports remain retained.
Independent review added explicit native boundary attachment checks and stale displayed/submitted/executed plan protection. Missing native boundary assignments are now detected.

independent_review.scope: Read-only source fidelity and native evidence review; no code edits or model API calls
physical_conclusions: AirCore three source dimensions/turns/current, inch units, mixed asymptotic exterior and flux/current inductance are preserved. Wheeler numbers remain separate empirical comparators.

UniformField original shell permeability data and magnetization directions are retained in a normalized construction. Source reports magnitudes; negative signed native components are compatible. Analytic targets 0.5 T and 2/3 T are kept distinct from published numerical approximations.
COMSOL transfer preserves 0.2 m wire radius, 1 m separation, equal opposite 1 A currents, unit permeability and uniform DC current. Native planar depth 1 m makes force N numerically equal N/m.

Finite circular A=0 exterior is an explicitly disclosed replacement for COMSOL infinite elements. Weighted stress and Lorentz estimates have distinct method identities. No cross-solver byte-equivalence or vendor certification is established.

Current recipe builders generate trusted local Lua from validated parameters. Downloaded scripts/operations are not executed; passive source models supply shell coefficients. This is a bounded compiled recipe layer using the knowledge graph, not arbitrary knowledge-node execution.

findings.description: Boundary definitions are checked but segment/arc boundary property assignments are not. Geometry signature also omits assignments. In-memory copies of all three actual native families with every arc boundary index reset to zero still passed physical_assignments verification. Existing saved native artifacts have correct assignments, so this does not invalidate their measured results.
findings.requested_change: Verify exact intended outer contour boundary assignments and absent interior/axis assignments as appropriate; add mutation regression check.
findings.resolution: Every retained model still passes the stronger checker. Removing all arc boundary assignments is now detected for all 15 actual native models.

findings.description: Air mesh length is domain_radius/40*mesh_scale. Increasing radius from 10 to 20 m also coarsens this global mesh. The 2x2 sweep provides combined numerical sensitivity, not an isolated boundary error estimate or monotone convergence proof.
